items.title: 阿曼｜杜库姆渔业工业区8.7公里道路及基础设施合同授出
items.title_en: Oman | Duqm Fisheries Industrial Zone 8.7km roads and infrastructure contract awarded
items.summary: OPAZ授出杜库姆渔业工业区配套基础设施合同，包括8.7公里道路、两个环岛及供水、排污、供电、照明和通信工程。
items.summary_en: OPAZ awarded infrastructure works for Duqm Fisheries Industrial Zone, covering 8.7km of roads, two roundabouts, water, wastewater, power, lighting and communications.
items.why_it_matters: 主合同授出后可跟进承包商的材料与设备采购。
items.why_it_matters_en: Contract award opens follow-up opportunities in contractor procurement.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注管材、泵阀、电缆、照明、施工机械和工业区工程配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track pipes, valves, cabling, lighting, construction machinery and industrial utilities.

items.title: 阿联酋｜Aldar与Arada达成11亿迪拉姆住宅交易
items.title_en: UAE | Aldar and Arada agree AED1.1bn Aljada residential transaction
items.summary: Aldar与Arada就沙迦Aljada三个住宅组团签署约11亿迪拉姆远期购买协议，涉及9栋建筑及超过1100套住宅。属于地产交易而非施工总包授标。
items.summary_en: Aldar and Arada agreed a roughly AED1.1bn forward purchase of three Aljada residential clusters comprising nine buildings and over 1,100 homes. This is a property transaction, not a new construction award.
items.why_it_matters: 资产交易可能带来交付与装修供应链需求，但应确认实际开发与采购主体。
items.why_it_matters_en: The transaction may support delivery-related supply opportunities, subject to developer procurement plans.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注室内装修、门窗、卫浴、厨房、家具、机电与智能家居。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track fit-out, doors and windows, bathrooms, kitchens, furniture, MEP and smart home systems.

items.title: 卡塔尔｜Aamal与中国中铁隧道集团推进隧道管片合作
items.title_en: Qatar | Aamal and China Railway Tunnel Group explore tunnel segment cooperation
items.summary: Aamal旗下APC与中国中铁隧道集团签署隧道管片合作框架，探索卡塔尔及周边市场的预制混凝土管片及相关供应链业务。并非已中标工程。
items.summary_en: Aamal subsidiary APC signed a cooperation framework with China Railway Tunnel Group to explore precast tunnel segments and related supply chains in Qatar and the surrounding region; no project award is implied.
items.why_it_matters: 合作框架为中国工程技术与本地制造资源对接提供窗口。
items.why_it_matters_en: The framework opens a partnership pathway between Chinese tunnel expertise and local fabrication.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注预制混凝土、模具、钢筋、工程设备及专业施工合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track precast concrete, moulds, reinforcing steel, equipment and specialist delivery.

items.title: 坦桑尼亚｜约420亿美元LNG项目接近敲定协议
items.title_en: Tanzania | US$42bn LNG project nearing agreement
items.summary: 坦桑尼亚财政部长表示，政府接近就约420亿美元液化天然气开发项目敲定协议，参与方包括Equinor和Shell。项目尚未全面开工。
items.summary_en: Tanzania's finance minister said the government was nearing agreement on a roughly US$42bn LNG development involving Equinor and Shell; full construction has not begun.
items.why_it_matters: 超大型能源项目若推进，将形成长期工程和供应链需求，但近期采购尚不确定。
items.why_it_matters_en: The potential mega-project could generate a significant long-term construction pipeline, though near-term tenders remain uncertain.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注储罐、管道、钢结构、工程设备和未来技能劳工供应。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track storage tanks, pipes, steelwork, machinery and prospective skilled labour supply.

items.title: 阿曼｜Oman Cables投资逾1000万里亚尔兴建第三座工厂
items.title_en: Oman | Oman Cables invests over OMR10m in third factory
items.summary: Oman Cables Industry在Al Rusayl工业城为第三座工厂举行奠基仪式，投资超过1000万阿曼里亚尔，建设42米高电缆制造塔，引入数字化和AI生产能力。
items.summary_en: Oman Cables Industry broke ground on its third Al Rusayl Industrial City factory, with over OMR10m investment, a 42m cable production tower and digital/AI manufacturing technologies.
items.why_it_matters: 工厂建设与扩产可带来自动化设备和工业工程配套机会。
items.why_it_matters_en: Capacity expansion may create industrial automation and facility-supply demand.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注工业建设、智能制造、生产自动化和电缆产业链合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track factory works, smart manufacturing, production automation and cable-sector partnerships.

items.title: 巴林｜Muharraq城市更新一期工程推进
items.title_en: Bahrain | Muharraq urban renewal Phase 1 advances
items.summary: Muharraq Development Project一期涉及6个社区的约300套住宅建设及修复，配套道路、建筑立面、停车场和景观。项目已处于推进阶段。
items.summary_en: Phase 1 of the Muharraq Development Project includes construction and rehabilitation of approximately 300 homes across six communities, plus roads, facades, parking and landscaping.
items.why_it_matters: 已执行的城市更新更适合寻找后续分包及设备材料采购。
items.why_it_matters_en: Ongoing renewal works may provide downstream subcontracting and supplies.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注建筑装修、门窗、石材、照明、景观和住宅配套。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track fit-out, windows, stone, lighting, landscaping and housing products.

items.title: 西班牙｜马德里地铁11号线机电工程合同约1.05亿欧元
items.title_en: Spain | Madrid Metro Line 11 MEP works contract worth about €104.6m
items.summary: 马德里地铁11号线Plaza Elíptica–Conde de Casal区段机电设备安装合同约1.046亿欧元，欧盟采购资料显示获标联合体包括SYNEOX RAIL、ORTIZ及IMESAPI。属于已授标工程。
items.summary_en: A roughly €104.6m systems installation contract for Madrid Metro Line 11 Plaza Elíptica–Conde de Casal was awarded to a joint venture including SYNEOX RAIL, ORTIZ and IMESAPI, according to EU procurement data.
items.why_it_matters: 工程包已有承包方，供应商应跟进其采购链而非重新投标主合同。
items.why_it_matters_en: The awarded consortium presents a supplier engagement route rather than an open main tender.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注地铁机电、布线、安装辅材、通风及专业工程。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track metro electrical and mechanical equipment, cabling, ventilation and specialist installations.

items.title: 葡萄牙｜约950万欧元混凝土轨枕采购招标
items.title_en: Portugal | Approximately €9.5m concrete railway sleepers tender
items.summary: Infraestruturas de Portugal为Alentejo线Casa Branca–Beja区段现代化采购混凝土轨枕，估算金额约950.46万欧元，招标编号10020414，截止2026年10月26日。
items.summary_en: Infraestruturas de Portugal tendered concrete sleepers for the Casa Branca–Beja section of the Alentejo railway modernization, estimated at about €9.5046m, ref 10020414, closing 26 October 2026.
items.why_it_matters: 明确的铁路材料采购，但参与者需满足欧盟技术标准及招标资质。
items.why_it_matters_en: A defined rail material procurement subject to EU technical and eligibility requirements.
items.gci_opportunity: 关注混凝土轨枕、预制构件生产技术、铁路认证及本地合作。
items.gci_opportunity_en: Track sleepers, precast technology, rail certification and local partnerships.
